szoveg_eredeti:
Not having access to experts is no longer a bottleneck when it comes to learning new things. You can ask AI to make a 5 minute video for you to learn anything. Here’s one on how a fab makes chips.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Aravind Srinivas megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Computer (@AskPerplexity); megjelent: 2026-10-21T17:56:06+00:00; link: https://x.com/AskPerplexity/status/2112966168915104007; média: videó, 314 másodperc]
Computer wrote and produced a five-minute film on how a chip gets made, drawing on 13 technical references from ASML, Intel, TSMC, Cadence, SkyWater, and IEEE Spectrum.

Skip to 3:59 for why "3 nanometers" doesn't mean what it sounds like.
